title: What Open-Source Projects Tell Their Coding Agents: A Census of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
abstract: arXiv:2610.31715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents can be guided with instruction files in a repository. We examine this emerging practice through a census of popular, active GitHub repositories in thirteen languages, treating each repository's root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md as one instruction set. Agent instructions appear in of repositories and of the most-starred; where both files exist, CLAUDE.md usually points to AGENTS.md. We analyse statements using model-assisted annotation and human review. The annotations reveal a practical mix of project knowledge and rules about code, building and workflow. Collaboration rules name concrete requirements, from test plans to commit formats, yet of directives give no reason. Projects disagree on AI attribution: commit-message rules more often prohibit it than require it, while pull-request rules more often require disclosure. translated_title: 开源项目对编码智能体说了什么：AGENTS.md 与 CLAUDE.md 文件普查
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可以通过仓库中的指令文件获得引导。我们通过对十三种语言的热门活跃 GitHub 仓库进行普查来考察这一新兴实践，将每个仓库根目录下的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 视为一个指令集。智能体指令出现在一定比例的仓库以及星标最高的仓库之中；当两个文件同时存在时，CLAUDE.md 通常指向 AGENTS.md。我们采用模型辅助标注与人工审核相结合的方式分析这些指令语句。标注结果显示，指令内容是项目知识与关于代码、构建和工作流规则的实际混合体。协作规则会指明具体要求，从测试计划到提交格式，但相当一部分指令并未说明理由。各项目在 AI 署名问题上立场不一：提交信息规则禁止 AI 署名的情况多于要求署名，而拉取请求规则则更倾向于要求披露 AI 的参与。三分之一的指令集带有与生成器相关的签名、工具插入的内容块、共享文本或其他生成痕迹（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 这项研究首次对十三种语言的活跃 GitHub 仓库中的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 指令文件进行大规模普查，系统揭示了开源项目向 AI 编码智能体传达的指令构成（项目知识与代码、构建、工作流规则的混合），以及各项目在 AI 署名披露等问题上的立场分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale census of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction files across active GitHub repositories in thirteen languages, systematically revealing what instructions open-source projects give to AI coding agents and their diverging stances on AI attribution.
